title: Today in one sentence
text: Stocks ended Tuesday with Meta up 2.6% and AMD up 1.9%, while Rocket Lab fell 2.3%; at the open, watch how stocks react to the inflation report that comes out at 8:30 am Eastern today.

title: Inflation report at 8:30 am today
text: The September inflation report (how fast prices are rising) comes out today, Oct. 14. Economists polled by Dow Jones expect prices to be up 0.6% from August and 3.6% from a year ago. Those are forecasts, not facts. A higher number can make people think interest rates will stay high or go up, and stocks that are expensive compared with their profits, like AMD, often feel that most. The Fed meets next on Oct. 27 and 28.

title: TSMC reports on Thursday
text: TSMC makes chips for NVIDIA, AMD and Broadcom, so its report on Thursday, Oct. 15, is a clue for the whole AI chip business. Earlier this month it said its sales for July to September were a record, about 50% more than a year before. TSMC closed Tuesday at $445.12, about 9% below its highest price of the past year ($487.47). The report will also tell us what TSMC expects for the months ahead.

title: Bond yields keep climbing
text: The 10 year Treasury yield (what the US government pays to borrow for ten years) averaged 4.99% in September. That is the highest in the past 12 months and up from 4.06% a year earlier. When bonds pay more, stocks have to look more attractive to compete, which is one reason expensive stocks can wobble.

title: Health and industrial stocks lagged
text: On Tuesday, Nasdaq healthcare stocks fell about 1.7% and industrial stocks about 1.8% on average. In our list, Eli Lilly fell 1.4%, Intuitive Surgical 1.3%, Lockheed Martin 1.5% and Rocket Lab 2.3%. One day does not make a trend, but it shows the market favored energy, utilities and tech that day.

title: Lesson 6: What is the 52 week range?
text: The 52 week range shows the lowest and highest price of a stock over the past year. It helps you see where today's price sits. AMD's range is $188.22 to $658.52, and it closed at $605.53, about 89% of the way up. Vertiv's range is $147.82 to $379.94, and it closed at $237.29, only about 39% of the way up. A price near the top means the stock has run a lot; a price near the bottom may mean people are worried, or that it is on sale. The range does not tell you which one is true. It only tells you where to start asking questions.

title: What this covers
text: Prices are from Tuesday's close. Analyst price targets and company numbers are available for NVIDIA, TSMC, AMD, Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, GE Aerospace and Lockheed Martin. Broadcom, Vertiv, Rocket Lab, Eli Lilly and Intuitive Surgical have prices and risk scores only. This is information to learn from, not advice to buy or sell.
